why: This is the merge step of merge sort done on linked nodes: two pointers walk the two sorted lists, and a tail pointer links whichever head is smaller.
hints: Both lists are sorted. Which node must come first in the merged list?
Compare the two heads, link the smaller one after a tail pointer, and advance in that list. A dummy head node avoids special-casing the first link.
Loop while both lists have nodes, then attach whatever list remains in one step. O(n + m) time, O(1) extra space, reusing the existing nodes.
pitfalls: On equal values take from list1 first (<=); both copies must stay.
Attach the leftover tail in one step instead of looping over it.
